status: Exploratory additional analysis of archived fitted scores; no refitting
fold_grid: linspace(min(g), max(g), 101) separately for each draw and panel
evaluation_unit: compound; arithmetic mean of profile scores within compound
pairs: all positive-negative compound pairs, weight one
tie_rule: exact equality of float64 pair differences; no rounding or tolerance in H
scope: Finite observed pair sets and fixed saved decompositions. Folded maps are direction-varying stress tests, not ordinary monotone calibration or a model of retraining or distribution shift.
grid_interpretation: Observed grid maxima are lower bounds on the supremum over the full admissible class. The deterministic upper guarantee is supplied by the theorem, not by the finite grid.
